tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.

My favorite dinner or meal would be pasta and red sauce, specifically marinara sauce. I would prefer it to be penne pasta because I like to eat the pasta by putting two pieces on the fork tines. I love red sauce so much. It's acidic and delicious. I never get sick of it. It's especially good with spicy italian sausages.
